response.justification: MOC-2019-0141 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 27 September 2019 as a scheduled change under management of change; no event precedes it in the record. The management of change record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2021-0155, PRO-MIN-003 and STD-MEQ-007.
